ui.onboarding.connect.intro: Local Operator needs an AI account to work. Radient is the easiest: one browser sign-in and nothing to paste. Already pay for ChatGPT or Claude? Sign in with that instead. Anything else is under More providers.
ui.onboarding.default_model.connected_pi: {brand} is connected. Pick the model new chats should use.
ui.onboarding.default_model.empty_helper: No providers are connected yet. Go back a step to connect one.
ui.onboarding.default_model.intro: New chats use this model. Every agent can pick a different one later.
ui.onboarding.default_model.none_connect: No provider is connected yet. Go back to connect one, or skip setup and connect one later from the chat.
ui.onboarding.default_model.nothing_save: Nothing will be saved: your Local Operator can't list {brand} models yet, so setup finishes without a default model. Pick one in Settings before your first message.
ui.onboarding.extras.greeting_done: {name} is your chief of staff. Her conversation is where you pick up with her, and it is one keystroke away in the sidebar. You can also skip straight to a new chat.
ui.onboarding.extras.greeting_owed: {name} is your chief of staff. She will say hello first, ask what to call you and what you would like help with, and show you around. You can also skip straight to a new chat.
ui.onboarding.modal.error.aida_open_fail: {name}'s conversation could not be opened, so you are in a new chat instead.
ui.onboarding.search.each_key_saved: Each key is saved on your device as soon as you leave its field.
ui.onboarding.search.intro: Agents can look things up while they work — today's prices, this week's news — instead of relying on what the model already knows.
ui.onboarding.search.mode.free_detail: Uses a rotating pool of free providers — DuckDuckGo, Tavily's free tier, Exa and Parallel. No key needed; the pool is shared, so searches can be slower at busy times.
ui.onboarding.search.mode.keys_detail: Bring your own keys for the search providers you use.
ui.onboarding.search.mode.label: Search setup
ui.onboarding.search.row.save_failed: The key could not be saved.
ui.onboarding.modal.steps_total: {total, plural, one {{total, number, ::group-off} step} other {{total, number, ::group-off} steps}}
